shortDescription: Manage utility license assignment on BIG-IPs from a BIG-IQ

options.name: device
options.description: When C(managed) is C(false), specifies the address, or hostname, where the BIG-IQ can reach the remote device to register. When C(managed) is C(true), specifies the managed device, or device UUID, you want to register. If C(managed) is C(true), it is very important you do not have more than one device with the same name. BIG-IQ internally recognizes devices by their ID, and therefore, this module cannot guarantee the correct device will be registered. The device returned is the device that is us

options.name: device_password
options.description: The password of the C(device_username). When C(managed) is C(false), this parameter is required.

options.name: device_port
options.description: Specifies the port of the remote device to connect to. If this parameter is not specified, the default is C(443).

options.name: device_username
options.description: The username used to connect to the remote device. This username should be one that has sufficient privileges on the remote device to do licensing. Usually this is the C(Administrator) role. When C(managed) is C(false), this parameter is required.

options.name: key
options.description: The registration key from which you want choose an offering.

options.name: managed
options.description: Whether the specified device is a managed or un-managed device. When C(state) is C(present), this parameter is required.

options.name: offering
options.description: Name of the license offering to assign to the device.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the device is assigned the specified license. When C(absent), ensures the license is revokes from the remote device and freed on the BIG-IQ.

options.name: unit_of_measure
options.description: Sets the rate at which this license usage is billed. Depending on your license, you may have different units of measure available to you. If a particular unit is not available to you, the module notifies you at licensing time.
